text: The specification organizes the system into six DDD bounded contexts: `ArtifactGraph` (canonical schemas, referential integrity, artifact evolution), `StewardRuntime` (trigger intake, locking, orchestration, retries), `Verification` (oracle runs, replay, equivalence, resilience sampling), `Adapters` (stable plugin interfaces and lifecycle compatibility), `ExportSurface` (deterministic agents/skills/MCP exports), and `Optimization` (prompt packs, eval datasets/results, and promotion gates).
